steps.name: Requirements phase
steps.description: Analyze existing codebase (op-gateway, op-mcp, op-dbus-model) and generate initial requirements.md (PRD).

steps.name: Technical Specification phase
steps.description: Define the technical approach for scanning and generating specifications in spec.md.

steps.name: Planning phase
steps.description: Break down the work into concrete implementation tasks in plan.md.

steps.name: Generate core specifications (gateway, mcp, model)
steps.description: Generate detailed specs (requirements, design, tasks) for op-gateway, op-mcp, and op-dbus-model.

steps.name: Generate op-introspection specifications
steps.description: Analyze and generate specs for the op-introspection crate.

steps.name: Generate op-state-store specifications
steps.description: Analyze and generate specs for the op-state-store crate.

steps.name: Review and Finalize
steps.description: Perform a final consistency check across all generated specifications in .kiro/specs/.

steps.name: Generate specifications for op-core
steps.description: Analyze crates/op-core and create requirements.md, design.md, and tasks.md in .kiro/specs/op-core/.

steps.name: Generate specifications for root op-* components
steps.description: Analyze op-api, op-worker, op-cli, op-storage, op-parser and create specs in respective .kiro/specs/ directories.

steps.name: Generate specifications for op-execution-tracker
steps.description: Analyze crates/op-execution-tracker and create specs in .kiro/specs/op-execution-tracker/.

steps.name: Generate specifications for op-plugins
steps.description: Analyze crates/op-plugins and create specs in .kiro/specs/op-plugins/.

steps.name: Final Review and Task Completion
steps.description: Perform a final review of all new specifications and mark the task as done.
